title: Catalytic redox-neutral carboxylation with CO2
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,11583-11623
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00877H, Review Article
Si-Shun Yan, Tian-Yu Gao, Yi Liu, Yi-Fei Chen, Jun-Ze Zuo, Qin-Fang Zhang, Lei Song, Wei Zhang, Jian-Heng Ye, Da-Gang Yu
The catalytic redox-neutral carboxylation of readily accessible starting materials with CO2 leads to valuable carboxylic acids with high atom economy and selectivity. In this review, we summarize the latest developments and challenges in this field.
